source.author: lucan
source.text: Nunc sum tibi gloria maior, A me quod fasces, et quod pia turba senatus, Tantaque discessit regum manus.
source.text_original: Nunc sum tibi gloria maior, / A me quod fasces, et quod pia turba senatus, / Tantaque discessit regum manus.
source.text_english: Now I am a greater glory to you, because from me have departed the fasces, and the loyal throng of the senate, and so great a company of kings.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_original: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum / secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_english: Go, you are mine; already the dutiful band of the silent summons you to the groves, and Father Aeolus, flying about, calls you to the hidden fields.
